messages:
maria: Heads-up - our APAC project is hitting a hard quota limit blocking new GPU instances in asia-east1. Need help opening/escalating with GCP.
raj: Which quotas exactly? GPUs, vCPUs, or networking?
amaria: GPUs (A10G + T4) and regional external IPs. Also vCPU region quota is close to limit for the project.
amar: typo — sorry. @raj can you sanity-check the numbers? I pulled the console: `GPUS (asia-east1): 8/8`, `vCPUs (asia): 240/240`, `External IPv4: 10/10`.
raj: Got it. That's blocking the customer pilot next Wed. I'll open a support case now with billing + projected spend.
amir: cc @amir (account manager) — please escalate once case is created. We should ask for temporary quota bump and organizer-level increase if needed.
jessica: Can we move some non-prod workloads out of asia-east1 to free up headroom for the pilot?
amaria: We've already moved what we can; most infra is pinned to that region for latency. Non-prod has like 20% of usage, won't be enough.
raj: Created case: GCP ID `123456789012345`. Submitted justification "pilot for enterprise customer requiring low-latency inference; estimate 40 A10G-hours/day; monthly spend ~ $18k". Waiting for initial ack.
amaria: Paste the case response when it comes in. Also include request for increase to `GPUS: 32`, `vCPUs: 600`, `External IPv4: 30` for asia region.
(2 minutes later) gcp-support: Hi team — case 123456789012345 received. Need project billing account number and confirmation of service account owner. Also asked for org admin to approve if limits at org level.
amaria: Billing account ID: `B-98a7c6d5`. I just forwarded to our Org Admin (amir).
amir: On it. I requested an ownership confirmation and flagged as P1 due to customer SLA. I've also looped in our GCP TAM.
jessica: Cost note — jumping to 32 A10G would be ~3x current commit. We should check if a Dedicated pool (reserved capacity) is cheaper for the pilot window.
amaria: Good point. @amir can you get a quick estimate on Dedicated vs on-demand? We need a decision by EOD tomorrow.
amir: I'll ask TAM for a pricing spreadsheet. Also asked GCP to provide a provisional increase just for 2 weeks to cover the pilot while we evaluate Dedicated.
raj: GCP responded: "Provisionally approved +20 GPUs for 14 days pending org approval. Case 123456789012345 -> escalation 1234567890-ES. Please provide org admin email."
amaria: Sending org admin email now to gcp-support.
sre-oncall: FYI I added an alert to notify if GPUs in asia-east1 exceed 24 to avoid surprise usage.
deploy-bot: deploy-prod: attempted scale-up of inference-pool in asia-east1 — failed: quotaExceeded.
amaria: Thanks. Once provisional bump is active we'll retry.
raj: Follow-up: GCP asked for a short architecture note showing GPU utilization pattern + expected scaling behavior. I'll draft that and post here for review.
amaria: Drafted note attached in thread (will paste in the case). Key points: prefix caching keeps token costs low; we need burst headroom for 60 concurrent sessions; average job duration ~ 15 mins.
amir: TAM confirmed they can expedite org-level increase if we send a signed PO or commit. I'll check procurement.
jessica: Let's also estimate cost if we move some inference replicas to us-west1 as a fallback — maybe cheaper and faster quota to get.
amaria: Good idea, add to plan B.
gcp-support: Update: provisional bump has been applied. GPUs available in asia-east1: now 28/32. vCPUs remain under review. We will update case 123456789012345 when vCPU change is approved.
amaria: Excellent, thanks everyone. I'll start the pilot warmup and monitor. Keep this thread for any more status updates.
raj: I'll mark internal ticket INFRA-1029 with the case ID and link to this thread.
amaria: End-of-day checklist: 1) confirm vCPU increase (amir) 2) pricing compare Dedicated vs on-demand (amir/jessica) 3) plan B to spill to us-west1 (raj/jessica).
amaria: :eyes:
